{{Quote|Sergeant Dorne, reporting for duty, Lieutenant! I'll prepare my Regulation 6 Personnel Transfer documents at once!|Elara Dorne|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
The '''Regulation 6 Personnel Transfer document''' was a document that [[Soldier/Legends|soldiers]] in the [[Republic Army]] had to fill out during an official transfer between units.
